comments.text: Okay not a medical professional but 10:36 reminded me of when I had to do a similar test but on piglet cadavers identifying organs and whatnot. Don't recall what my score on that was or what I was trying to identity in this story but I couldn't get my teacher's attention to help out when the piglet flopped over at some point before I got to it so I couldn't even see what the flag was poked into. I would have moved it myself but it was covered in embalming fluids of course so I couldn't touch it with my bare hands and I didn't want to get in trouble for running over to grab some gloves without permission (the way I see it is I'd be leaving where I was supposed to be during a test and thus get in trouble for "cheating"). I almost ran out of time (yeah it was timed too) to look at the piglet before the teacher noticed I needed help and she got the piglet back on it's back. I get she was helping another student, I think he struggled with test taking because I remember seeing her talking to him at his spot in the cadaver line the entire time I was trying to get her attention, but I was really nervous I was going to look like an idiot by leaving the question blank.
